about: The one machine-readable record of each covered module's layer and function category. docs/LAYER_MODULE_OWNERSHIP.md is generated from it by scripts/render_module_ownership.py; the knowledge graph reads layer and category from here. The category is a view over the layers and never moves a file.

scope.statement: Covers the Python modules at the repository root, in aurora_internal/ and in aurora_manifold_directory/ only. It is a functional categorization of those modules, not an ownership map of the whole repository.

not_covered.what: Shell and batch launchers, HTML and JSX prototypes, JSON maps, build specs and requirements

basis.reviewed: Its code and its importers were read; duties says what it actually does.
basis.name_and_docstring: Assigned from name and docstring, then screened by the import and file-write scan, which raised no conflict.

categories.name: Entry and runtime
categories.holds: Entry points, the turn loop and process orchestration.

categories.name: Foundation and constraint layers
categories.holds: Foundational contract, IVM lattice, X/T/N/B/A constraint physics, NonComp, pressure and leverage.

categories.name: Beings and dimensional systems
categories.holds: I-State beings, dimensional systems, consciousness assembly and simulation (the L2 to L4 and L7 layer files).

categories.name: Crystal ops
categories.holds: The concept-crystal store, its evidence-based growth, ingestion and persistence, interaction crystals, and the crystal types QuasiArch shares with live processing.

categories.name: Memory
categories.holds: SediMemory, working and interaction memory, turn and resolution records.

categories.name: Reasoning and understanding
categories.holds: Representational resolution, propositions, the causal reasoning waveform, comparison and understanding.

categories.name: Genealogy, lineage and evidence
categories.holds: Constraint genealogy, code and ability lineage, function provenance, evidence qualification, WARP.

categories.name: Learning, dreams and development
categories.holds: Training, dreams, curriculum, evolution chambers, curiosity and habitat.

categories.name: Perception and expression
categories.holds: Sensory and hardware IO, intake, utterance parsing, expression and the reply well-formedness gate.

categories.name: Identity and language
categories.holds: Behavioral identity, language state, lexicon, grammar and word use.

categories.name: Governance, persistence and health
categories.holds: Persistence, checkpoints, autonomy, runtime faults and health, metabolic clock, fail-closed guards.

categories.name: Dual strata (surface and subsurface)
categories.holds: The dual-strata package and the surface/subsurface daemons and substrate.

categories.name: Bridges and external tools
categories.holds: Praxis, ACM, scouting, research dispatch and tool registries.

categories.name: Investigative and diagnostic
categories.holds: Read-only observers, canaries, probes, shadows, audits, reports and test setup. The QuasiArch observer stays here.

aurora_interaction_engine.py.duties: Interaction-lineage compression semantics: the facet sets and InteractionQuasiInnerStrata the interaction crystals use. Booted by aurora.py.

aurora_interaction_processing.py.duties: Interaction crystal formation, promotion, collapse and routing. aurora.py boots InteractionProcessing; its crystals subclass the QuasiArch crystal types.

aurora_internal/aurora_boot_parity.py.duties: Tracks parity between aurora.py boot_aurora and aurora_runtime.py boot_stack. Only tests use it.

aurora_internal/aurora_episode_slip_prof.duties: EpisodeRubricSummary feeds structural-pressure steering, the specialized avatar synthesizer and the dream genealogy bridge.

aurora_internal/aurora_fault_audit.py.duties: AST audit for swallowed exceptions, used by the fault instrumentation script and tests.

aurora_internal/aurora_local_llm_bridge..duties: Fail-closed guard: the retired local-model adapter keeps its names so stale imports fail closed, and there is no model path. Only tests import it.

aurora_internal/aurora_pf1_5_instruments.duties: wellformed_and_coherent decides whether a candidate reply is accepted, in aurora.py and aurora_working_memory.py. Measuring PF1.5 is its second job.

aurora_internal/aurora_quasiarch_observe.duties: The QuasiArch observer. aurora.py boots it at L8+; it observes and writes its own state (interventions, ghost relics); its answers carry authoritative False and active steering is opt-in.

aurora_internal/aurora_runtime_health.py.duties: Readiness semantics (degraded is not ready unless a caller opts in). Not wired into the runtime: tests and the fault audit use it.

aurora_internal/aurora_semantic_probe_ba.duties: Its function-word set _STRONG_FUNCTION_WORDS is used by aurora_proposition_frame.py and aurora_constraint_semantic_continuity.py, and its _parseable check by aurora_expression_perception.py. The probe battery itself is diagnostic.

aurora_internal/aurora_stack_trace_instr.duties: instrument_stack wraps runtime methods to record call lineage when AURORA_STACK_TRACE is on. Off by default.

aurora_internal/aurora_surface_doc.py.duties: full_report() gives aurora_surface_dispatcher.py its axis-to-surface routing table, and it writes a pressure log.

aurora_internal/aurora_system_introspect.duties: Source-derived map of executable functions (function ids are module.qualname) and per-turn decision provenance. aurora.py boots it and connects it to perception; it writes its own state and does not change response selection.

aurora_internal/dual_strata/perturbation.duties: Run by the topological semantic coordinator through run_perturbation_probe.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_development_in.duties: Development inquiry helper used only by the QuasiArch observer.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/__ini.duties: Re-exports the package. aurora_interaction_processing.py imports CrystalInstance and CrystalOrder through it, which loads every submodule when interaction processing boots.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/cryst.duties: Crystal law: what each facet and relational point means at each crystal order (CrystalEngine, FacetLaw, RelationalPointLaw, CrystalOrder). QuasiArch reads it, and CrystalOrder is also the order ladder of the live interaction crystals in aurora_interaction_processing.py, so it is operational, not only investigative.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/dimen.duties: QuasiArch lineage memory (DimensionalMemory, IntegratedMemoryPipeline). Loaded with the package, but only the QuasiArch observer calls it.

CrystalInstance, RelationalPoint, crystal formation and promotion. InteractionCrystalInstance in aurora_interaction_processing.py subclasses CrystalInstance and builds RelationalPoint objects, and aurora.py boots InteractionProcessing, so these types hold live state.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/ghost.duties: Ghost relic records (GhostRelic, GhostRelicSystem). Loaded with the package, but only the QuasiArch observer calls it.

aurora_learning_probe.py.duties: Standalone learning probe. Nothing in covered code imports it.

conftest.py.duties: pytest setup only: puts the repository root on sys.path for tests/. Not part of the runtime.

run_full_competency_gauntlet.py.duties: Script entry point for the competency gauntlet; writes its own results. Nothing in covered code imports it.

run_gauntlet.py.duties: Script entry point that runs the gauntlet and writes its own results. Nothing in covered code imports it.

run_probe_battery.py.duties: Script entry point for the semantic probe battery; writes its own results. Nothing in covered code imports it.
